description: No clean concept; best approximation: fires when the opponent has stones massed on and around cell (2,2) (third row, column 2), especially an open vertical three in column 2 or opponent stones at both (2,2) and (1,3) while I do not hold (0,4) or (3,1). It is very context-sensitive: one of my stones next to the cluster often switches it off, and it also fires in some lost positions without this pattern.
effect: Weak and inconsistent: forcing it to max shifts move probabilities by at most about 0.15 (e.g. +0.14 to column 4 in one position, +0.13 to column 5 in another); zeroing it changes almost nothing.
notes: Layer 4 pole -. Tried: O at (2,2)&(1,3) (F1 .14); opp threat cells at (3,0)/(3,1)/(3,2)/(4,0)/(2,3) (F1 .13); vertical-three-col2 OR (2,2)-(1,3) diagonal (F1 .21, best); hand-weighted cell sum (F1 .18); cluster counts (F1 .13-.14). Minimal pairs show strong location specificity (shifting the O triangle (1,2),(1,3),(2,2) one column kills it) but idiosyncratic context effects (moving my unrelated stones from col 6 to col 5 flips it). Many misses are near-lost positions. Synthesis: dense O block in cols 1-3 rows 0-2 reaches 21.5 vs dev max 14.6. Possibly a random direction or mixture.
